title: what do you think of/about ...?你对...有什么看法？
explanation: 我们在询问别人的看法时，常会说：“你觉得这个主意怎么样？”或“你觉得怎么样？“在英语里就是用“What do you think of/about...?”这个句型来表达。

examples.en: What do you think of this serial drama?
examples.note: “What do you think of/about...?”这个句型在口语中很常见，意思是“你认为……怎么样／如何？”。这个句型用来询问对方对某事或某人的看法和态度。

examples.en: What do you think about this book?
What do you think of this movie?
examples.note: of或about后面要接名词、代词或动名词。

examples.en: What do you think of me?
What do you think of going shopping?
